semantic.justification: Original raw RBBIDataWrapper constructors now create actual borrowed header/table/trie/status views and owned rule strings, preserving initialization/error/version/width order, byte equality/hash, same-owner references and failed-init counter behavior. Native comparison matches 189 full initialized-field/array/reference/equality traces, including adopted/borrowed/embedded storage and 8/16/32-bit trie paths. Fresh UnicodeString::fromUTF8 uses the actual ICU converter and the existing managed UTF16 value binding; 65536 byte-pair values and 213 counted/null/long values match the original class. No public writable-buffer/alias allocator API, replacement UDataMemory owner, iterator or engine factory is supplied. Actual UDataMemory construction/loader, public iterator/engines and word/title/UNO/NatNum12 installation remain pending; native allocation/deletion/COW/thread/physical ABI and use after final release remain unverified.
